blocker: the stock TUI owns the single attached client of its app-server runtime; no observer role, stock-TUI extension, or shared broker exists
upstreamAnchor: docs/adr/0009-app-server-boundary.md:143 — one AppServer instance owns one attached root runtime; the protocol does not model several simultaneous attached observers
construction: vibe/app_server/stdio.py serves exactly one stdio connection per process; a second client cannot connect at all
vibe/cli/textual_ui/app.py attaches in-process through a private memory transport pair (vibe/app_server/local.py), so the stock TUI is the only client of its runtime

vibe/app_server/_handler.py session/start and session/continue reject a second attach on the same connection with conflict 'A session is already attached' (legacy backend); the unified backend replaces the attached backend under a lifecycle transition instead of multiplexing
callbackOwnership: the attached client captured at initialize owns every server-to-client callback/call and clientTool/* request; capabilities are per-connection and cannot be shared with a second observer

secondSessionStartSameConnection.backend: stock default (legacy Python) backend in an isolated home
secondSessionStartSameConnection.implication: one attached session per connection; no re-attach, no multiplexing
secondSessionStartSameConnection.unifiedBackendNote: in a home where the Unified Harness is rolled out, session/start replaces the attached backend with a new session id instead — still exactly one attached client

crossProcessResumeOfLiveSession.implication: a second app-server process cannot attach a session that is live in another process, so a second vibe-app-server cannot control the pane's runtime

turnStartWithIdempotencyKey.outcome: accepted with a PublicTurn in 'in_progress' carrying the exact turn id and session id

enqueueDuplicateKeyDifferentInput.message: Idempotency key was already used with different input: <key>

queueSteer.message: The installed Unified Harness does not support queued steering
queueSteer.implication: queue-steer is legacy-backend only in this release; a future adapter must not assume it
